mutation.adapter: Parse go-mutesting pass/fail output into targets[]: one target per package/file with killed/survived counts.

notes: Copy this file to quality-gate.config.json in the adopting repository root and keep mutation.report at artifacts/mutation-report.json.
The shipped quality-gate.yml passes this file to mutation_gate.py run --config on every pull request and trunk push; MUTATION_COMMAND is only a fallback.
Godog is the industry-standard Cucumber/BDD runner for Go and writes JUnit XML through --format junit:<path>.
go-mutesting is the standard open-source mutation testing tool for Go; gotestsum remains the fallback JUnit reporter.
gocyclo -over 10 ./... is a second complexity opinion; exclude vendor/ and generated code.
Add services: or testcontainers when acceptance tests require real middleware.
Never mark a gate command non-blocking or ignore its exit code.
